dash_intro: State of the knowledge base and the review queue.
repo_intro: Canonical texts. Only human-approved content is fully trustworthy.
repo_fallback: No text in “{target}”. Showing the “{shown}” text instead.
repo_not_cleared: Full text may not be stored (paraphrase only)
repo_delete_confirm: Really delete “{name}” with all its translations?
repo_edit_warning: Saving changes sends the text back to draft: it must be approved again.
f_cleared: Full text may be stored (decision made: yes)
arg_intro: Opponent claim → counter-punch → sources. The Shield uses only approved or AI-verified cards.
arg_ai_notice: AI-generated card. A human must approve it before it can be used in public content.
arg_edit_warning: Saving changes sends the card back to draft: it must be approved again.
arg_draft_intro: The drafter model writes cards with exact quotes. Code checks each quote is verbatim in the source, then an independent model audits them.
arg_draft_result: Created: {created} · rejected (quote not in source): {rejected} · AI-verified: {verified} · need review: {flagged} · errors: {errors}
arg_draft_unavailable: Drafting is not configured: set LLM_DRAFTER_* and LLM_AUDITOR_* (different model families).
review_intro: Work for a human: flagged, stale and draft items, plus a random sample of AI-verified cards. Most-used first.
review_alert: The disagreement rate is high: the auditor prompt or model needs checking.
shield_intro: Paste an opponent’s attack. The answer uses only the cards and sources found, and quotations come from the database, never from the model.
shield_preset_swiss_text: Neutrality is dodging responsibility: Switzerland profits from other people’s wars.
shield_preset_double_text: You are Russian stooges, and equal distance is betraying our allies.
shield_preset_paradox_text: Beating swords into plowshares is naive: without an army nobody will defend us.
shield_include_drafts: Include drafts and flagged cards (they will be clearly labelled)
shield_drafts_warning: Draft mode: results may contain unverified material. Do not use them in public statements.
shield_evidence_empty: Evidence appears here once you send an attack.
shield_unverified_warning: Warning: the answer contains a quotation that is not in the sources found. Do not use it without checking.
shield_error_generic: Could not get an answer. The evidence above is still valid.
shield_no_source: No strong enough source was found for this attack. Rather than improvise, add or approve a relevant source or argument card in the repository.
shield_retrieval_only: No chat model is configured (LLM_CHAT_*), so only the cards and sources found are shown.
content_intro: Drafts for X, Facebook, short video and press statements — built only from approved sources and cards. Nothing is published automatically: a human reads, edits and copies.
content_brief: What should the text be about? (topic, attack, event)
content_brief_placeholder: e.g. Reply to the claim that neutrality is dodging responsibility…
content_allow_ai: Allow AI-verified but not human-approved cards (the draft gets a watermark for editing)
content_allow_ai_hint: By default only human-approved material is used.
content_watermark: ⚠ DRAFT — contains AI-verified material that no human has approved. Needs editorial review before publication.
content_no_material: No approved sources or cards match this topic, so nothing was generated. Approve relevant material in the repository, or allow AI-verified cards.
content_not_configured: No chat model is configured (LLM_CHAT_*), so generation is unavailable. The evidence shown alongside is still valid.
content_edit_hint: You can edit the text freely. Any change clears the “reviewed” status and re-runs the checks.
content_review: I have reviewed this and take responsibility for the text
content_unreviewed_material: Contains material no human has approved
content_check_unverified_quotes: No quotations that are not in the sources
content_check_unsupported_numbers: Numbers and dates appear in the material or the brief
dash_sampling_ok: The spot-check sample is reviewed by humans; a high disagreement rate raises an alarm.
dash_no_backup: There is no backup at all.
warn_origin_missing: ORIGIN is not set: form submissions will be rejected behind a proxy (adapter-node assumes https). Set ORIGIN to the public URL of the app.
warn_auth_disabled: Login is disabled (AUTH_DISABLED). Use this for local development only.
warn_admin_password_in_env: ADMIN_PASSWORD is still in the environment. Remove it after the first start.
warn_no_backup: There is no backup. Take one now and check the schedule (BACKUP_INTERVAL_HOURS).
warn_backup_stale: The latest backup is out of date. Check the server logs and free disk space.
warn_backup_same_disk: Backups live on the same disk as the database. Set BACKUP_DIR to another disk, or copy them off this machine regularly.
warn_models_same_family: The drafter and the auditor are the same model family; the audit loses its independence.
warn_chat_missing: No chat model is configured (LLM_CHAT_*): the Shield shows evidence only and the Content Engine is unavailable.
warn_pipeline_missing: Drafter and auditor models are not configured (LLM_DRAFTER_*, LLM_AUDITOR_*): cards cannot be generated.
warn_embedder_off: Embeddings are off (EMBEDDER=none): search is lexical only and will not match Polish attacks to English sources.
warn_sampling_alert: Humans often overturn the auditor on the spot-check sample. Check the auditor prompt and model.
warn_stale_cards: Some cards need re-auditing (a source changed after they were verified).
warn_nothing_approved: No text has been approved by a human yet, so the Shield and the Content Engine will find nothing.
settings_mismatch: The new passwords do not match.
settings_password_rules: At least 12 characters. You will be signed out on your other devices.
